# 氢能与可持续航空燃料

_Hydrogen & Sustainable Aviation Fuels_

可持续航空燃料、氢燃烧和氢燃料电池涉及不同的能量路径与系统约束。NASA 的公开研究和试验介绍可用来建立入门索引。

_Sustainable aviation fuels, hydrogen combustion and hydrogen fuel cells involve different energy paths and system constraints. Public NASA studies and test descriptions provide starting references._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 区分燃料生产与生命周期、机上储存、发动机兼容性及排放评价。

_Distinguish fuel production and life-cycle effects, onboard storage, engine compatibility and emissions evaluation._

- 把氢燃烧与燃料电池电推进分开整理，避免把二者当作同一方案。

_Index hydrogen combustion separately from fuel-cell electric propulsion._

- 对减排结论记录比较基准、燃料组成和试验条件。

_For an emissions claim, record the comparison baseline, fuel composition and test conditions._

_A public presentation on dual-fuel concepts and system challenges._

_A NASA and Boeing test account concerning soot from different fuel blends._
